headline: Sunderland 0-0 Leeds: Premier League – as it happened
body: Sunderland stay bottom of the Premier League table after a hard-fought goalless draw played in horrible conditions 1 min Peep peep! Leeds, in their yellow change strip, kick off from left to right as we watch. Prokofiev is on the tannoy at the Stadium of Light , which means the teams are about to take the field.
